answer_text: No. UMG Article 8.2 does not exempt residential constructions from the inter-building distance of Article 8.1. It allows a different implantation only for technical equipment serving safety, a public service, water management, energy distribution such as transformers, or a household waste storage local needed for selective sorting (c-01)[8.2: 'Les constructions peuvent être implantées différemment de la règle définie en 8.1 lorsqu'il s'agit d'équipements techniques liés à la sécurité, à un service public, à la gestion de l'eau']. The full 8.2 list contains no residential, student-residence or young-worker-housing category, so neither the Résidence Sociale Étudiante nor the Résidence Jeunes Actifs qualifies (c-02)[8.2 paragraph on PDF p.326 / printed p.325 checked in full].
additional_context: Page correction to the input reference: Article 8.2 sits on PDF p.326 (printed 325), not PDF p.327 (printed 326). PDF p.327 begins at Article 11.1. Article 8.1 starts on PDF p.325 (printed 324) and its 6 m clause continues onto PDF p.326. The exemption is limited to the listed technical and public-service categories. If a project were ever framed as public-service equipment, that would need separate review, but neither residential use is described that way.
